title: Proclamation 590/2008: right of access to information held by public bodies and duty to publish
claim: Ethiopia's Freedom of the Mass Media and Access to Information Proclamation No. 590/2008 establishes that all persons have the right to seek, obtain and communicate any information held by public bodies, except as expressly provided, and imposes on public bodies a duty to publish information concerning their organizational structure, main duties, decision-making procedures, services, records, and relevant facts concerning important decisions and policies that affect the public.
evidence_summary: Article 12 of the Proclamation establishes the right of access to information: all persons have the right to seek, obtain and communicate any information held by public bodies, except as expressly provided. Article 13 imposes a duty to publish: public bodies shall publish information concerning their organizational structure, main duties and responsibilities, decision-making procedures, services and their scope, and public records, and shall publish all relevant facts concerning important decisions and policies that affect the public.
source_excerpt: Right of Access to Information: All persons have the right to seek, obtain and communicate any information held by public bodies, except as expressly provided for by this Proclamation. ... Duty to Publish: Any public body shall publish information concerning: (a) its organizational structure, main duties and responsibilities; (b) the norms, guidelines and decision-making procedures it applies; (c) the services it provides and their scope; (d) public records; ... Any public body shall: (a) publish all relevant facts concerning important decisions and policies that affect the public; (b) give reasons for decisions it makes affecting the public.
interpretation: Normative evidence of the statutory transparency framework for access to public information in Ethiopia, in force since 4 December 2008 (published in the Federal Negarit Gazeta, 14th Year No. 64). It establishes a right of access to information and proactive publication duties on paper; it does not itself evidence the implementation or enforcement of these rights in practice.
citation: Freedom of the Mass Media and Access to Information Proclamation No. 590/2008, Federal Negarit Gazeta 14th Year No. 64 (4 December 2008), Arts. 12-13.
methodology_or_basis: Direct quote of Articles 12-13 of the proclamation. Text verified against the official Ministry of Justice law page and an official copy of the proclamation text.
relevant_policy_or_law: Freedom of the Mass Media and Access to Information Proclamation No. 590/2008
